newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar softens, closes at 465 to $.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar softens, closes at 465 to $.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar reversed its recent course on Thursday as it softened against the dollar closing at 465.00/465.25 in a quieter session, traders said.
"Today was a less turbulent session than yesterday with a number of banks even buying dollars," said one trader.
On Wednesday, the bolivar firmed over four bolivars as soaring demand for bolivar-denomiated assets combined with strong supplies of dollars took the unit to a 464.00/465.25 per dollar close.
But many brokers saw today's weakening bolivar as only a blip, adding that Friday would see it appreciate again.
As in recent sessions, the Central Bank did not participate and only monitored the market from the sidelines, traders added.
